name: search_run_log
description: Search this run's event log — role conversations, tool calls, and results — for a case-insensitive substring and return a short excerpt of each matching event's raw log line. An optional type filter (for example llm_call) narrows the search to one event type before matching. Use it to locate where a finished role discussed something, then read around it. The inquiry task names what to look for. A run with no log yet returns an unavailable result.

detailed: Searches the run's event log and returns capped match excerpts.

whimsical: {source} is dusting the ship's log for fingerprints

detailed: tool {participantRole} is searching the run's log

query.description: The text to search for, matched case-insensitively anywhere in the event's raw log line.

type.description: Optional: only search events whose type equals this value, such as llm_call or tool_result.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of matches to return (default 20; hard-capped).
